## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem it Solves
What problem does this feature address? Who benefits from it?

## Target Edition
- [ ] Institutional Edition (`main` branch) — for teachers & students
- [ ] Explorer Edition (`speechmate_general` branch) — for travelers & public
- [ ] Both editions

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you think this could be implemented.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Additional Context
- Mockups, screenshots, or references
- Related features or issues
- Impact on offline functionality (SpeechMate must remain offline-first)
